snippet.title: Kumarn : The Wandering Spirit | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Once Sacred, Now Lost...

Kumarn, a young child spirit, and his loyal companion Zeb were once guardians of their village, where humans and spirits co-existed in harmony to bring luck, prosperity and protection to those who lived there. 

When a forbidden ritual tears them from their shrine, they are cast into a nightmarish world of whispering forests, forsaken villages and forgotten temples where haunting ancient folklore has awakened into a terrifying reality.  
 
Relentlessly stalked by twisted creatures and restless ghosts born from Thai tales that mourn, hunger and hunt them, they must brave a land consumed by ancient darkness to find their way home. 

Lurk in the shadows to outsmart malevolent horrors and use your wits to find safe passageways to escape, but beware... this cursed world is eager to claim you, and each step will either bring you closer to your rightful place or leave you as another wandering soul lost to the dark. 

Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit is a terrifying single player adventure for fans of the genre popularised by Little Nightmares and Reanimal. Blending stealth, environmental puzzles and tense platforming within deeply unsettling environments shaped by Thai folklore.
